description: 9-channel stereo mixer with three-band EQ, pan and four aux sends on every channel, 3 stereo groups fed by any channel, four aux returns, and an X/Y crossfade across the groups

params.text: Sets the level of the stereo main output, applied after every channel, group and aux return has been summed
Sets how much of that channel reaches the main mix, or the group it is routed to
Sets how much of that group reaches the main mix
Sets how much of that aux return reaches the main mix
Pans that strip between the left and right sides of the mix, centred at noon
Cuts or boosts the high band of that strip, flat at noon
Cuts or boosts the mid band of that strip, flat at noon
Cuts or boosts the low band of that strip, flat at noon
Sets how much of that strip is sent to the AUX 1 bus, taken after its level slider unless the pre-fader switch for that strip is on
Sets how much of that strip is sent to the AUX 2 bus, taken after its level slider unless the pre-fader switch for that strip is on
Sets how much of that strip is sent to the AUX 3 bus, taken after its level slider unless the pre-fader switch for that strip is on
Sets how much of that strip is sent to the AUX 4 bus, taken after its level slider unless the pre-fader switch for that strip is on
Sets the level of that aux send output, applied to the sum of every send knob feeding that bus

inputs.text: The left input of that channel, and the source for both sides when the right input of that channel is empty
The left return input of that aux, carrying the effect sent out on that aux bus back into the mix
The right input of that channel, which makes the channel stereo rather than mono
The right return input of that aux, which makes the return stereo rather than mono
Attenuates the level slider of that channel: 10V leaves the slider where it is, 0V silences the channel, and an empty jack reads 10V
Adds to the pan knob of that channel, minus 5V for hard left and plus 5V for hard right
Moves the group crossfade left and right, 0-10V, and an empty jack reads 5V; the X and Y pair fade between the four group corners
Moves the group crossfade up and down, 0-10V, and an empty jack reads 5V; the X and Y pair fade between the four group corners

outputs.text: The left side of the main mix
The right side of the main mix
The left side of that group, taken after its EQ, pan, level slider and crossfade, and before its mute unless Pre-Mute is turned off on the menu
The right side of that group, taken after its EQ, pan, level slider and crossfade, and before its mute unless Pre-Mute is turned off on the menu
The left side of that aux send, for feeding an effect
The right side of that aux send, for feeding an effect

notes: every channel level slider comes up at the bottom, so a new mixer passes nothing; raise the slider of each channel you patch
menu: Pre-Mute — takes the group outputs before the group mute rather than after it
Gain x1.5 — raises the top of every level slider from unity to one and a half times
Do Not Mute when SOLOing — keeps the aux returns audible while a channel is soloed
